title: tech-feed-catalog entry
description: One feed in the catalog. Measured fields are written by scripts/validate.py — do not fill them in by hand in a pull request.

name.description: Shown verbatim in notifications and in the catalog table. Keep it short and human ('Google AI Blog', not 'google-ai-blog-rss').

url.description: The feed URL for RSS/Atom entries, or the sitemap.xml URL when type is 'sitemap'.

type.description: Only for sites that publish no RSS feed. Omit for ordinary RSS/Atom feeds.

prefix.description: Required when type is 'sitemap': only URLs starting with this prefix count as articles.

site.description: The human-facing page, so a reader can see what they are subscribing to.

kind.description: blog = narrative posts; changelog = many short entries; release-notes = version announcements. This drives the radio-friendliness estimate.

source_mode.description: Set when the article pages block automated fetchers (Cloudflare challenge etc.), so consumers submit the feed summary instead of the URL.

volume.description: Measured: posts per month over the last 90 days.

radio_friendly.description: Measured: how well this feed suits a generated audio overview, derived from kind, volume, and how much body text the feed ships.

has_timestamps.description: Measured: whether every entry carries a publish/update time. Feeds without them need ID-based read tracking.

latest_post.description: Measured: date of the newest entry seen.

status.description: Measured: 'stale' means nothing new for 180 days; 'broken' means the feed could not be fetched or parsed.

status_detail.description: Measured: why the status is not 'ok'.

last_checked.description: Measured: when the weekly validator last fetched this feed.
